news.headline: Central Florida Sat Nov 28 — Melbourne clear and 57°F at 7 AM, turning cloudy with a high of 68°F and low of 59°F, rain chance near 0-3% all day; a River Flood Warning remains in effect for the area; warmer Sunday (high 77°F) with scattered thunderstorms possible Sunday night (20% rain chance)

Lakeland leads the nation in declining apartment construction — RentCafe/Yardi report (via Business Observer, Nov 27): Lakeland-Winter Haven is on track to add just 1,066 apartments in 2026, down 74.3% from 2025, the steepest drop in the U.S.; Jacksonville fell 72.4% to 2,063 units, while Florida statewide still adds 50,392 units, second only to Texas — Orlando 8,790 and Tampa 7,596 projected

Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31, 2026 — the edition in effect on the permit application date governs the work for the life of the permit; the 2026 codes are based on the 2024 International Codes and include the 2023 National Electrical Code, and Miami-Dade portal submissions after 4 PM Dec 30 will be subject to the 2026 edition

Copper surged Fri Nov 27 — LME copper rallied as much as 6.5% intraday, its biggest jump since January, to trade above $12,600 a tonne, and was 4.7% higher at $12,429.50 a tonne as of 2:01 PM Shanghai time, rebounding as AI-stock sentiment stabilized after the metal fell back from September's record near $15,000

HVAC shipments — AHRI data reported by ACHR News: U.S. shipments of central air conditioners and air-source heat pumps rose 27.3% in September to 673,286 units (central AC up 40.9% to 370,855; heat pumps up 13.8% to 302,431), with year-to-date combined shipments up 7.9% to 7.06 million; gas furnace shipments slipped 0.4% in September and are down 4.4% for the year

Markets close Fri Nov 27 — Wall Street ended the shortened Black Friday session sharply higher: Dow rose 591.99 points (1.18%) to 50,774.94, S&P 500 gained 1.60% to 7,297.49 and Nasdaq Composite gained 543.70 (2.31%) to 24,129.50; ahead, the Fed meets Dec 8-9

FHFA Nov 24: the 2027 conforming loan limit for one-unit properties rises to $855,400 in most of the U.S., up $22,650 (2.72%) from 2026, with a high-cost ceiling of $1,283,100; limits will be higher in all but 24 counties, reflecting the rise in average U.S. home values between Q3 2025 and Q3 2026

Florida Live Local Act fight — Attorney General James Uthmeier filed a Nov 12 amicus brief backing a developer whose workforce-housing application Sarasota County refused to consider under the Live Local Act (SITC, Inc. v. Sarasota County); on Nov 4 Circuit Judge Hunter W. Carroll ruled against the county in the related D.R. Horton, Inc. v. Sarasota County case and ordered that project to move forward in review

NBA — Miami Heat beat the New York Knicks 108-105 on Fri Nov 27 at Madison Square Garden in NBA Cup play, ending New York's six-game winning streak: Bam Adebayo scored a team-high 25 points and Giannis Antetokounmpo had 22 points and a career-high 23 rebounds; next: Orlando Magic at the Washington Wizards Sat Nov 28 at 5 PM ET

NFL — no Florida team plays Sat Nov 28; ahead Sun Nov 29 at 1 PM ET: New York Jets at Miami Dolphins (CBS, Hard Rock Stadium) and Tennessee Titans at Jacksonville Jaguars (FOX, EverBank Stadium); Mon Nov 30 at 8:15 PM ET: Carolina Panthers at Tampa Bay Buccaneers (ESPN, Raymond James Stadium)
